items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: Fé Dodo, call un mon petit frère. Fé Dodo, tu as du lolo. Maman est en haut, papa est en bas. Fé Dodo. But did something come after that Fé Dodo? I can't remember now.

ctx.x: Can you try it off a minute? Can you remember a Fé Dodo? Let's see.
Fé Dodo, call un mon petit frère. Fé Dodo, tu as du lolo. Maman est en haut, papa est en bas. Fé Dodo. But did something come after that Fé Dodo? I can't remember now.

Well, next time I come, I'll bring some, the words of quite a few old French songs. And I'll, well, give you a few of them to refresh your memory. Probably if you get a little bit of them, you'll remember more.
